findings.title: Composer arbitrary command execution via a malicious package's Perforce source URL (GHSA-rvx4-ffvw-m9q3, CVE-2026-84361)
findings.summary_md: GitHub's composer/composer security page lists GHSA-rvx4-ffvw-m9q3, published October 29, 2026, as a high-severity advisory for arbitrary command execution through a malicious package's Perforce source URL. The Composer releases index credits the fix for the malicious Perforce URL command injection to this advisory and CVE-2026-84361. The disclosure predates the 2.11.2 and 2.2.32 release covered by this story.
